# Mad River Pools (Mad River Pool Construction)

> Pool builder in Maitland, Florida, serving the Orlando area and Central Florida since 1998. Builds concrete (gunite), fiberglass and vinyl liner pools, spas and hot tubs, spools and swim spas, paver and travertine decks, and renovates and repairs existing pools. Every job is supervised by owner and master pool builder Mike Ramée. State license CPC 1457780 (verifiable on myfloridalicense.com). Proud dealer of Latham Pools. Phone (407) 810-3453, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Eastern Time.

## Pools

- [Concrete pools](https://madriverpools.com/#pools): any size, shape and features; finishes in quartz aggregate (Diamond Brite), pebble (PebbleTec) or Beadcrete; about 3 to 3½ weeks from dig to deck.
- [Fiberglass pools](https://madriverpools.com/#pools): one-piece Latham shells with limited lifetime warranties; about two weeks; complete installation or support for owners who install it themselves.
- [Vinyl liner pools](https://madriverpools.com/#pools): custom shapes on polymer or concrete walls, wide choice of liner patterns and colors, lifetime warranty on the superstructure; 2 to 2½ weeks.
- [Vinyl liner shapes](https://madriverpools.com/#shapes): rectangles, Roman ends, modified Grecian, kidney and modified ell shapes the company has installed, from 10 × 22 ft to 18 × 75 ft.

## Around the pool

- [Spas and hot tubs](https://madriverpools.com/#backyard): added to an existing pool or built new with landscaping and a paver deck; spa renovation in fiberglass or concrete.
- [Pavers and decks](https://madriverpools.com/#backyard): pavers, travertine, or concrete with Kool Deck, for pool decks, patios, walkways and driveways.
- One source for the whole project: permitting, excavation, decking, electrical work, screen enclosures, landscaping, low-voltage lighting, irrigation and retaining walls.

## Renovation

- [Renovation and repair](https://madriverpools.com/#renovation): ripped or rotted vinyl liners, cracked or faded fiberglass, cracking or deteriorating concrete and gunite, and complete remodels, including pool-in-pool renovations.

## Company

- [Our work](https://madriverpools.com/#work): photos of concrete, fiberglass, spa and deck projects.
- [Financing](https://madriverpools.com/#financing): HFS Financial and Lyon Financial.
- [Free home visit](https://madriverpools.com/#visit): free and with no obligation; the company aims to reply within 48 hours. Email madriverpool@gmail.com. Office: 1704 Shawnee Trail, Maitland, FL 32751.
